messages:
Anya (Partnerships): Quick sync – need alignment on marketplace pricing hooks for the upcoming joint announcement with Nimbus HW partner. Two PO options: A) flat 25% off for 12m commit; B) tiered buckets (12m/$150k → 20%, 12m/$300k → 30%) + renewal credit. Which is simpler to operationalize?

Matt D: Leaning tiered. SIs can push to thresholds. Also we should standardize SKU naming so marketplace maps cleanly to HW bundles.

Sophia P (Finance): Tiered ok if we cap aggregate discount exposure. Need a max effective discount per customer and a clause for prepay vs commit billing.

Raj (SalesEng): Customers asking about prepay. Suggest prepay = extra 5% off, otherwise commit-only gets base tier. Also propose a 6mo ramp clause for big enterprise pilots.

Anya (Partnerships): Draft proposal: tiered commit with optional prepay bonus, renewal credit = 10% of prior-year consumption applied as one-time credit at renewal. Cap effective discount at 35% across levers. Sound reasonable?

PartnerOpsBot: Draft PO created in marketplace sandbox: mp-2026-nimbus-hw-01 — https://marketplace.internal/mp-2026-nimbus-hw-01

Matt D: Timeline check — we need listing live 48h before joint press. Ops, can you confirm deploy window?

PartnerOpsBot: Listing deploy scheduled for 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC. Can be moved if needed.

Sophia P (Finance): Approve the cap and renewal credit mechanics. Add clause: credits expire 90 days after issuance and are non-transferable. Also require annual invoice prepay for any >$300k tier.

Anya (Partnerships): Perfect. I'll circulate the final PO draft and announcement blurb to Legal and PR. @Raj, can you own SI enablement content for the bundle? :thumbsup:

Raj (SalesEng): On it. Will share a 1-pager and playbook by EOD tomorrow.

Anya (Partnerships): Thanks all — will reconvene if Legal flags anything. Closing thread once PR & PO are signed off.
